category: Svelte 5 virtual list / list virtualization component

repo_triage._comment: Open PRs/issues not opened by jaysin586, plus threads awaiting reply. Uses self_repo.

self_features: Svelte 5-native component API with snippets and TypeScript generics
Dynamic height measurement without requiring a size map up front
Built-in infinite loading hooks for feed and pagination workflows
Imperative scroll method with index and alignment control (scroll / scrollToOffset)
Vertical and horizontal layouts, including reactive orientation switching
non_goals: Grid / masonry / 2-D virtualization (focused on one-dimensional lists)
RTL horizontal mode (horizontal is LTR-only in the current release)

watchlist.note: cross-framework virtualizer (React/Vue/Solid/Svelte); strong momentum; Svelte support worth watching
